answer: The mews are quiet before the morning flight, and the falconer weighs the lure in his hand. Proof of falconer lure via jess knot tally — a lure the falconer knots only after 26 lures run true, each lure jessed by the falconer himself. The umber is the perch the bird returns to. The haven is the glove the falconer wears at dawn. The copper is the bell that calls the hawk home. Faking the knot tally costs a man 26 long weeks, and his hands still tremble when he finishes.
